title: CNC & VMC Machining
summary: 3-axis milling, turning and drilling within a 1300 × 800 mm envelope — on production parts and on our own tooling.
intro: Our CNC and VMC line handles the features that pressing and welding cannot hold: tight-tolerance bores, machined faces, reamed and tapped holes, and precision locating features. It works on finished components and as a secondary operation on formed parts — so a job needing both stays on one purchase order.

sections.heading: Secondary operations without a second supplier
body: A pressed bracket that needs a reamed locating hole is a common requirement and a common source of delay, because it usually means shipping parts out for machining and back again — two transport legs, two goods-inward checks, and a batch you cannot see for a week.
We machine in-house, in the unit next door to the press shop. The part never leaves, the inspection record stays continuous, and the lead time is ours to control.

sections.heading: The same machines cut our dies
body: Our VMC capability serves both production parts and the tool room, where it machines die components, fixture bodies and gauge details.
That dual use is deliberate. Machinists who cut tooling to tool-room tolerances bring the same standard to production parts, and the tool room gets machine time whenever a die needs correcting.

sections.heading: Envelope and capability
body: Production machining runs within a 1300 × 800 mm working envelope with 3-axis milling, supported by turning and drilling for cylindrical and hole features.
The tool room adds a BFW VMC with a 700 × 1250 mm bed, four surface grinders, milling, turning and drilling equipment.

seo.description: 3-axis CNC and VMC machining in Faridabad within a 1300 x 800 mm envelope. Secondary operations on pressed parts, plus in-house die and fixture machining.
